author: Mark Atwood
text: Removed spurious dependency on PKIX-amgn.8 (2026-05-12). The edge existed because both lived under the PKIX-amgn realignment umbrella, but PKIX-jbvb is about S/MIME BR sub-profile *types* in pkix-profiles-cabf (Organization-/Sponsor-/Individual-validated tiers) which are pure Profile-trait impls -- they do not consume zlint-derived catalog metadata. With PKIX-amgn.8 closing WONTFIX, the edge would have wrongly perpetually blocked .jbvb. Other blockers (.amgn.2 / .4 / .6) all closed; this issue is now reachable.
